findings.rule: docs/specs/in-progress/admin-analytics-work-items.md#WI-10 (deliverable: 'SMS messages + est. cost') + WI-07 SMS-cost precedent
findings.title: SMS estimated cost hardcoded to 1 CZK/SMS instead of per-fleet SmsUnitCostCzk
findings.detail: BuildFleetRowAsync returns SmsEstimatedCostCzk: smsCount (line 205, comment '// 1 CZK per SMS'). FleetSettings.SmsUnitCostCzk is a per-fleet configurable value (default 1). The sibling WI-07 revenue endpoint computes SMS cost as smsCount x SmsUnitCostCzk read from FleetSettings (default 1 when no row) and is test-pinned to that. A fleet with a non-default rate shows correct cost on its own /analytics/revenue tab but a wrong (1 CZK/SMS) cost on the SuperAdmin platform table. Numbers are correct only for default-config fleets; no test exercises a non-default rate here so the divergence is silent.
findings.recommendation: Read SmsUnitCostCzk per fleet (FleetSettings, default 1 when absent) and multiply, matching the WI-07 revenue endpoint; add a test with a non-default rate.

findings.title: PushSubscriptions and FleetAdmin Users queries lack AsNoTracking()
findings.detail: ProcessFleetAsync reads Users (lines 175-180) and PushSubscriptions (lines 189-192) purely to send pushes; neither is updated in this scope, but neither uses AsNoTracking(). The WeeklyDigestMarker is the only entity intentionally tracked for the insert. Tracking the read rows is unnecessary overhead. WeeklyDigestMarkers marker-exists check (line 125) is an AnyAsync so unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Add AsNoTracking() to the Users and PushSubscriptions read queries.

findings.title: Log message templates repeat the class name
findings.detail: Templates such as 'WeeklyDigestJob sent {FleetId} ...', 'WeeklyDigestJob skipped ...', 'WeeklyDigestJob push failed ...' prefix the class name, which rules/logging.md says is already attached via the SourceContext enricher and must not be repeated in the template. Property values (fleet id + counts only) are otherwise correct and PII-free per the WI-10 requirement.
findings.recommendation: Drop the 'WeeklyDigestJob' prefix from the message templates; rely on SourceContext.

findings.title: AnonymizedPhone interpolated into raw SQL string in one query while parameterized elsewhere
findings.detail: The new-vs-returning bucket query (line 216) inlines the AnonymizedPhone constant into the SQL string literal ('AND customer_phone != '+420000000000''), whereas every other query parameterizes it via {AnonymizedPhone}. AnonymizedPhone is a compile-time const and truncUnit comes from a closed-set switch (AnalyticsWindow.TruncUnit -> day/week/month only), so there is no injection surface. Flagged only for consistency; safe as-is.
findings.recommendation: Optionally parameterize the sentinel in the FormattableStringFactory call for uniformity.

summary: WI-09 (GET /api/v1/analytics/customers, FleetAdmin) and WI-10 (GET /api/v1/admin/analytics SuperAdminOnly cross-tenant + WeeklyDigestJob) meet their WI deliverables and acceptance criteria. Build is clean under -warnaserror and the full suite passes at the expected 548/4 baseline. Tenant isolation is correct: every IgnoreQueryFilters() is justified and commented for the cross-tenant SuperAdmin/system-job context; the digest idempotency marker check correctly relies on the tenant query filter (WeeklyDigestMarker is ITenantEntity, CurrentTenant.FleetId set per fleet scope, no IgnoreQueryFilters). GDPR exclusion is implemented phone-first (customer_phone != sentinel) so anonymized rows count toward volume/revenue but are excluded from all identity metrics, with both sides tested (AC#5). Digest idempotency and partial-failure behavior are correct and tested: marker written exactly once per (fleet, ISO week) regardless of Gone/Failed outcomes, and a Gone recipient does not abort remaining recipients (AC#8). SqlQuery hygiene follows CLAUDE.md: snake_case aliases throughout, nullable aggregates (avg_rating, last_order_at) mapped to nullable doubles/DateTimeOffset?, MAX(customer_user_id::text)::uuid workaround applied, FormattableStringFactory used for dynamic truncUnit. No direct order.Status writes (all reads). No blocking findings. One MEDIUM correctness gap (F1): the platform SMS estimated cost is hardcoded to 1 CZK/SMS rather than reading per-fleet SmsUnitCostCzk (the WI-07 revenue endpoint reads it) - produces wrong numbers only for fleets that customized the rate, silent because no test uses a non-default rate. Two MINOR (missing AsNoTracking on job reads; log templates repeat class name) and one INFO (sentinel inlined in one SQL string; safe). blocks_merge = false (0 critical + 0 high).
